text:
Lina (People Ops): Sofia accepted the offer but mentioned her EAD is expiring next week and she filed an I-765 renewal; she has the USCIS receipt (I-797C). Start date is in 10 days. Can she still onboard and be I-9 compliant?

Sofia (New Hire): Correct. Current EAD card expires on 2026-04-01. I mailed the renewal and got the I-797C receipt dated 2026-03-15. I can share scans. Hoping to start on 2026-03-30.

Tom (Hiring Manager): We really want her on the 30th. Any blockers?

Ellen (HR): If the existing EAD is unexpired on the start date, it counts as List A and we're fine. If it expires between start and when the renewal arrives, we need reverification. USCIS receipt alone is not a List A doc but can be used to show application filed; for employment authorization we still need unexpired card or acceptable List B+List C combo.

Priya (Legal): To be explicit: if her EAD is unexpired on 3/30, she can present that and complete I-9 normally. If the card expires while employed, we must complete Form I-9 reverification when she provides the new EAD. We should not re-run background checks because of this. Keep copies of the I-797C receipt as supporting file for audit trail.

Lina (People Ops): Action items: Sofia, upload scanned front/back of current EAD + I-797C receipt to secure HR portal. We'll complete I-9 with current card. When new EAD arrives, upload it and HR will reverifiy.

Sofia (New Hire): Uploaded both docs to the portal. Quick Q: will payroll or benefits be impacted if the new card arrives late?

Ellen (HR): Payroll won't change as long as SSN and tax docs are settled. Benefits enrollment can go live from your start date; coverage is not tied to EAD renewal timing. If reverification happens after open enrollment, HR will update the personnel file only.

Tom (Hiring Manager): Great — please confirm once I-9 is marked complete so we can schedule equipment.

PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: upload PII only to https://workday.company.secure/upload :lock:

Priya (Legal): One more note: keep a copy of any correspondence from USCIS about biometrics or case RFEs in the file. If USCIS issues a Request for Evidence and authorization is delayed, we'll coordinate accommodation.

Lina (People Ops): I-9 marked complete with current EAD. We'll set a reverification calendar reminder for 2026-04-02 and email Sofia a week before. Welcome aboard, Sofia!

Sofia (New Hire): Thanks everyone — excited to join. I'll upload any USCIS updates as they come in. :smile:

Ellen (HR): Logged in HR system: provisional benefits enrollment active 03/30. Payroll team notified.

Lina (People Ops): Closing thread; we'll reopen if USCIS timing changes.
